name: Lai Ni Bhaji nu Shaak
instructions: 1. Wash and finely chop the fresh Lai Ni Bhaji leaves.
2. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan until it reaches a smoking point.
3. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds; once they splutter, add asafoetida and minced garlic.
4. Sauté until the garlic turns golden brown, then add chopped green chilies.
5. Add the chopped greens to the pan and stir well.
6. Sprinkle turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Add a small piece of jaggery if desired.
7. Cover and cook on medium heat until the greens wilt and soften.
8. Remove the lid and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes to evaporate excess moisture and serve hot with bajra or jowar rotla.
description: Lai Ni Bhaji nu Shaak is a traditional, healthy vegetable preparation reflecting the agrarian roots of the union territory. It is commonly prepared in local households using fresh seasonal greens, providing essential nutrients and a distinctively pungent, earthy flavor profile characteristic of the local cuisine.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
